tools: rg declarations and exact caller searches
method.coverage_claim: All 8 Cargo package manifest paths and library/main roots inventoried; selected critical source ranges inspected below. Lexical declarations are navigation, not a compiler-resolved graph or a whole-code review.
method.proof_strength: Source implementation and caller presence only. No feature completeness, runtime acceptance, cross-platform correctness or compile-time reduction verdict.
method.inventory_method: All semicolon mod declarations under 8 package source roots; no macro expansion/cfg evaluation/general inline-scope parsing. Every row is LEXICAL_NAVIGATION_NOT_CFG_EVALUATED. Nearby attributes are immediately preceding attribute blocks across comments/blank lines, never sibling attributes. Explicit path attributes and the inspected Tauri commands inline scope resolved separately. Targets are file navigation, not compile liveness.

packages.name: handshake_core
packages.role: HTTP backend, embedded SurrealDB, EventLedger, domain/service/runtime contracts
packages.trap: --no-default-features still retains unconditional SurrealDB/RocksDB manifest edge; runtime-full without DuckDB has a build stub, not working recorder proof.

packages.name: handshake_document
packages.role: RichDocument model/domain, validation/projections and host-supplied create/save orchestration; narrow SurrealQL helpers
packages.trap: No embedded Surreal engine dependency, but the manifest compiles db wire types and all modules together; DocumentStore save transaction implementation still belongs to core.

packages.name: handshake_storage_support
packages.role: StorageError, bounded retries, keyed lock registry, canonical JSON/hash and timing context
packages.trap: Small existing owner suitable for shared helpers; its canonical serializer requires control-character coverage before native-file reuse.

packages.name: handshake-native
packages.role: eframe/egui native desktop composition, editors, shell mechanics, AccessKit/Argus, diagnostics
packages.host_bridge: Typed HTTP clients; no handshake_core Rust dependency in native manifest
packages.trap: A Studio UI harness depending on the whole native package compiles all editor/shell modules and rendering dependencies; thin reusable mechanics contracts should precede engine dependencies.

packages.name: handshake-diag-ring
packages.role: POD typed diagnostic schema, shared-memory seqlock SPSC ring and three-tier evidence records
packages.trap: No GUI/HTTP/tokio dependency; SPSC writer is not automatically safe for many concurrent Studio worker producers.

packages.role: External lifecycle-inverted watcher, passive ring reader, freeze/crash/child-stall detection, survivor forwarding
packages.trap: Reuse one host watcher and register long-running children; do not start a watcher per Studio crate or introduce engine dependency on whole watcher.

packages.name: toolkit_spike
packages.role: Explicit throw-away toolkit decision harness per manifest
packages.integration_disposition: Reference only; not Studio production dependency

packages.name: app
packages.role: Existing legacy Tauri/webview shell, React package at app/package.json
packages.integration_disposition: Do not adopt for new Studio GUI: CX-008-VIS requires native Rust, embedded webviews only in browser

call_chains.name: Native launch/render/diagnostics

steps.flow: Handle headless flags, install panic/OS crash handlers, create diagnostics ring, launch Palmistry before eframe.
Wgpu renderer mounts HandshakeApp.
Install fonts; 1-worker Tokio runtime; reuse diag session; operation watchdog; fresh_production_shell; spawn MCP.
raw_input_hook admits revalidated Argus actions; update bumps heartbeat, runs UI and timing/resource sample; refreshes model snapshot.
Shut MCP/runtime and explicit Palmistry Shutdown; Drop backstop shuts LSP clients before runtime.

call_chains.integration_implication: Studio mounts into existing native host lifecycle. Isolated engine harness must not accidentally launch host/Palmistry by importing GUI startup.

call_chains.name: Backend managed storage and route mounting

steps.flow: Resolve listen address; embedded control-plane storage; orphan/restart recovery; FR + diagnostics + LLM + capability/session registry.
Arc<dyn Database>, Surreal handle, FR/diagnostic traits and registries.
Required schema/corpus before serving.
Seed failure logged; freshness/resync retained.
Merge domain routers including knowledge_documents,knowledge_crdt,FR,Calendar,Locus,Stage,UserManual.
Routes merged directly and nested /api; managed store shutdown after serve ends.

call_chains.integration_implication: Keep Studio engine algorithms outside AppState and managed service setup; thin authority adapter handles persisted changes.

call_chains.name: Actual native RichDocument save transaction

steps.flow: Document-level authority is shared across views; canonical authority owns save/draft state.
Capture immutable content/workspace/version, reject duplicate in-flight, spawn backend save off-frame.
PUT /knowledge/documents/:id/save with expected_version, identity headers and10s timeout.
Authenticated ResourceBroker + scoped record user; not client-supplied actor as authorization.
Write permission, BlockTree/embed validation, CRDT lookup, delegate operations.
DocumentStore mutation first; post-commit receipt/backlinks/embeds/index are nonfatal and reported.
Delegate existing KnowledgeStore save.
Checked next version, keyed guarded mutation, replay key.
Compare version/read binding; transaction guarded document UPDATE + Loom/search projection + version record + draft delete + optional idempotency claim.
Apply saved exact request snapshot or distinct409 conflict; publish receipt attribution.

call_chains.integration_implication: Studio needs analogous one-document multi-view ownership and immutable request captures; current BlockTree cannot be assumed to represent raster/vector/timeline objects. Do not duplicate saved-document authority or route arbitrary graph bytes through RichDocument without spec.

call_chains.name: Native edit -> EventLedger -> FR mirror -> completion

steps.flow: One bounded ordered queue, asynchronous POST, bounded retry/error ring.
/api/workspaces/:workspace_id/flight_recorder/native_editor_event.
Server-derived identity/workspace authorization; schema/payload checks; canonical event IDs; document_saved requires authentic save receipt.
Durable pending EventLedger receipt first, then exact FR list/write, then completion receipt.
MIRROR_RECORDED only after exact FR exists; retry/reconciler closes partial state.

call_chains.integration_implication: Extend canonical event vocabulary for Studio commands/domain objects with schema/payload validators; do not instantiate one separate ledger/emitter per engine, and keep provenance independent from UI labels.

call_chains.name: Canonical shipped model steering

steps.flow: Token + shared UI snapshot/action channel + OS capture binds SwarmMcpServer.
Validated persistent per-client identity replaces connection identity; shared safety state.
Constant-time token; canonical argus.inspect/click/set_value/screenshot normalization; enqueue click/value, return receipt ID.
Reject queued actions on operator mutation; revalidate fresh snapshot then inject AccessKit events into same frame.
Isolated egui capture context projects reading mode and popup, same viewport; capture-mode guards prevent repeating effects.
snapshot->channel lock order; acknowledge_after_render and publish new tree together.

call_chains.integration_implication: Reusable Studio controls must emit live AccessKit nodes plus semantic completion hooks, not parallel fake widget tree. Pixel screenshot and structured state are complementary. Each agent needs scoped views/selection without overriding operator global focus.

call_chains.name: Public CRDT promotion bridge vs actual native save

steps.flow: Pure bridge input validity/promotion planning.
Append request+accepted/rejected decision atomically with causation through Database trait.

call_chains.integration_implication: This is an available public contract but no source evidence of native direct save calling it. Studio transaction/promotion integration must be explicit; typing a dependency is insufficient.

findings.finding: Repo already has multiple packages, but core and native remain broad compile closures; no shared root workspace.
findings.mitigation: Independently built Studio domain/engine leaf packages, host-contract leaf package and UI mechanics assets; host adapter owns integration closure.
findings.next_proof: Compiler timings per approved stable source/profile/features. File size does not prove compile cost.

findings.finding: core no-default-features cannot remove unconditional Surreal/RocksDB; default runtime-full activates tokenizers. DuckDB-free runtime-full exposes an unavailable stub.
findings.mitigation: No Studio engine dependency on handshake_core; extract/use data-only contracts at lowest owner. Do not accept stub compile as recorder runtime proof.

findings.finding: handshake_document is an existing successful narrow boundary pattern; concrete canonical document-save SQL remains in core.
findings.mitigation: Preserve existing extraction; define Studio host traits without recreating storage authority, and review whether pure model/Surreal wire adapter should separate further.

findings.finding: Native lib/interop comments say FR,Calendar,Locus,Stage endpoints absent, but current core route registrations and FR handler exist.
findings.mitigation: Use actual source/router signatures and fresh runtime proof for planning; source-root comments are not readiness authority.

findings.finding: EditorSurface retains a DESIGN-ONLY source header, but InteractionBus has executable selection/event callback dispatch to its default empty registry. No production surface registration was found; PaneFactory is the actual mount abstraction.
findings.mitigation: Implement an approved real EditorSurface registration plus PaneFactory adapter. Existing callback dispatch is reusable; source comments are stale about its dormancy. No embedded Studio or runtime proof exists from typing/registering a mock.

findings.finding: storage_support canonical_json_bytes escapes only quotes,backslash,newline,CR,tab; other U+0000..001F characters are emitted literally, including in object keys.
findings.mitigation: Before adopting as a native document serializer/hash contract, add approved focused adversarial control-character/roundtrip proof and standards-complete serialization without changing established hashes silently.
findings.next_proof: All JSON control characters and property keys; existing digest migration/conformance. No fix performed.

findings.finding: InteractionBus holds one global focused selection and in-memory undo scope; Argus supports per-client attribution and per-widget leases, but that does not create independent per-agent document views.
findings.mitigation: Publish scoped editor context/view identity, revision checks and canonical document transactions, with operator-owned focus priority. Keep existing owner instead of duplicating a bus per engine.

findings.finding: UiTreeNode has string value/actions/bounds but no explicit numeric ranges, units, temporal frame or render/color provenance.
findings.mitigation: One control contract/ParamSpec extension shared by slider/swatches/timeline assets; screenshots include exact graph/revision/frame/color/proxy stamps before visual change verdict.

findings.finding: Global DiagnosticsRecorder::record locks a buffer mutex and serializes shared-ring writes; DiagEvent only closed enums/integer counters.
findings.mitigation: Bounded numeric worker telemetry with nonblocking realtime producer queues and off-thread integration. Module/category identity allocation must preserve typed privacy allowlist; do not expand strings casually.

findings.finding: Public CRDT promotion ledger function has no production callers in the searched core Rust tree; current native save uses separate canonical document transaction.
findings.mitigation: Approve explicit Studio command->proposal/preview->promotion/persistence contract and real consumer; no assumed save/promotion equivalence.

findings.finding: Backend UserManual owns persisted registry/seed/freshness while native has a static section/content registration surface.
findings.mitigation: Bind new Studio manuals to one source and deterministic projection, with scope/route/diagnostic recovery/tool descriptors shared with control metadata.
